name: F9 library and panels honesty
description: Definition-of-done slice F9 (audit S10, S17, S18, S20, S21, S23) on an isolated fixture with one imported open-source library part. S10: Library › Manage › Add to project of an imported part now copies it into the project (UpsertComponentDefinition) instead of always failing, and the part then offers its editors. S23: the imported library's source address is plain text with a Copy button, not a link the webview cannot open. S17: disabled buttons say why (New part with no id; Simulation + Add with no net). S20: the Distributor scope stays on 'Distributor not configured' with no catalogue (the build's host is reserved). S21: the Performance section of Model settings is shown, not silently dropped. The refusal paths (New part and Annotate refused, settings unreadable) cannot be produced from the UI on a healthy build; they are covered by vitest (libraryPanel, rules, parts, ModelSettings tests) and the Rust parts_ipc / library_ipc tests.
